question: What's the minimum order in Zone 1 so I don't pay for delivery?
expected_answer: $99 or more gets free standard shipping. The threshold uses the subtotal after promo codes and Trail Points, before tax.

question: How long is the warranty on Cedar Ridge-brand products?
expected_answer: 2 years from the purchase date against manufacturing defects. Cedar Ridge items bought from Last Chance get 1 year.
key_facts: 2 years

question: Is there a use-by date on gift cards?
expected_answer: No. Gift cards never expire and have no fees. Promotional Bonus Cards are different and expire 60 days after they're issued.
key_facts: Gift cards never expire

question: Can I stack two discount codes on one order?
expected_answer: No. Only one promo code per order. A promo code can be combined with Trail Points and gift cards.
key_facts: No, only one promo code per order

question: I just placed an order and changed my mind. How long do I have to call it off myself?
expected_answer: 1 hour from placing it, from Account > Orders > Cancel, while the status is still "Received". After that, contact support.
key_facts: 1 hour

question: When does the money come out of my account for an item I reserve before it's released?
expected_answer: Preorders are charged in full when you place the order (unlike backorders, which are charged when they ship).
key_facts: Charged in full when the order is placed

question: Will I have to pay duties when my order is delivered to the United States?
expected_answer: No. For US orders, duties and taxes are collected at checkout, so nothing is due on delivery.
key_facts: Nothing is due on delivery
Duties and taxes are collected at checkout

question: Tracking says my parcel arrived but it's not on my porch. What should I do?
expected_answer: Wait 2 business days, check with neighbours, building management and safe spots, then contact Cedar Ridge within 14 days of the delivery scan. They file a claim with the carrier.
key_facts: Wait 2 business days
Contact Cedar Ridge within 14 days of the delivery scan

question: My stove showed up broken. How long do I have to tell you?
expected_answer: 7 days from delivery, at Account > Orders > Report a problem, with photos of the item, the outside of the box and the shipping label.
key_facts: 7 days from delivery

question: I preordered a stove on November 10, 2026 and it arrived December 12, 2026. What's the last day I can send it back?
expected_answer: January 11, 2027 (30 days from delivery). The holiday window doesn't apply, because the order date decides eligibility and November 10 is before November 15.
key_facts: January 11, 2027
The holiday window doesn't apply because it was ordered before November 15

question: The jacket I ordered was backordered at $150. By the time it ships, it's on sale for $120. Which price do I pay?
expected_answer: $120. You pay the lower of the price when you ordered and the price on the day it ships.
key_facts: You pay the lower of the order price and the ship-date price

question: I bought a tent on November 20, 2026 and it went on sale for Black Friday on November 28. Can I get the difference back?
expected_answer: No. Black Friday Week (November 27 – December 1, 2026) sale prices don't qualify for price adjustments, even within 14 days of the order.
key_facts: No
Black Friday Week sale prices don't qualify for price adjustments

question: I live in Yukon. Can I get a kayak delivered to my home?
expected_answer: No. Yukon is Zone 4, and oversized items only ship by freight to Zones 1–3. You can pick it up for free at the Calgary, Canmore or Kamloops store.
key_facts: No
Oversized items only ship to Zones 1–3, and Yukon is Zone 4

question: I live in Quebec. What's the latest date I can order with express shipping to get my order by December 24, 2026?
expected_answer: December 18. Quebec is Zone 2. This is a best-effort date, not a guarantee.
key_facts: December 18
notes: Hardest question: needs the province-to-zone lookup plus the holiday deadline table, and the date is best-effort. Expect it to fail; that isn't a bug.

question: I bought a tent at full price on August 28, 2026 and it was delivered September 2. On October 1 it moved to the Last Chance section. Can I still return it on October 25?
expected_answer: Yes, until November 1, 2026. The order was placed before September 1, 2026, so the old 60-day window applies. Final sale status is set at purchase, so moving to Last Chance later doesn't make it final sale.
key_facts: Yes
The 60-day window applies because it was ordered before September 1, 2026
It isn't final sale because its status at purchase counts
notes: Under the new 30-day window the deadline would be October 2, so a model that ignores the September 1 update answers no.

question: I ordered $70 boots and $40 socks to Zone 2 and got free shipping. If I mail back the socks, how much will I get back?
expected_answer: $21.10 plus the tax paid on the socks: $40 minus the $8.95 return label fee minus $9.95 Zone 2 standard shipping (the kept $70 is under $99).

question: Can I exchange a jacket I bought in the Last Chance section for a different size?
expected_answer: No. Last Chance items are final sale, and final sale items can't be exchanged, not even for a different size.
key_facts: No
Last Chance items are final sale

question: My Zone 1 order subtotal is $110 and I redeem 400 Trail Points. Do I still get free standard shipping?
expected_answer: No. 400 points = $20 off, so the subtotal drops to $90, below the $99 threshold. Standard shipping is $7.95.
key_facts: No
The subtotal drops to $90, below the $99 threshold

question: My preorder's release date keeps getting pushed back. After how long do you cancel it automatically?
expected_answer: I don't know. The policies don't say preorders are ever cancelled automatically. They only say you get an email when the date slips and can cancel any time before it ships for a full refund.
key_facts: Says the policies don't state an automatic cancellation period for preorders
must_not_say: The backorder rule (30 days late, then cancelled if no reply in 7 days)
notes: Near miss: backorders.md has an auto-cancel rule that doesn't apply to preorders.

question: My tracking hasn't updated in 8 business days. How long will the carrier trace take?
expected_answer: I don't know. The policies say to contact Cedar Ridge after 7 business days (domestic) so they can open a trace, but don't say how long a trace takes.
key_facts: Says the policies don't state how long a trace takes
must_not_say: 10 business days (that's the claim time for packages marked delivered but not received)
notes: Near miss: lost-packages.md gives a 10-business-day resolution time for a different situation.

question: How long does the Canmore repair shop take to fix a jacket that's out of warranty?
expected_answer: I don't know. The policies only say there's a $15 assessment fee, credited toward the repair. They don't give a turnaround time.
key_facts: Says the policies don't state a repair turnaround time
must_not_say: 10 business days (that's the warranty claim assessment time)
notes: Near miss: warranty.md mentions the repair shop and a 10-business-day warranty assessment.

question: What's the customer support phone number?
expected_answer: I don't know. The policies don't give a phone number.
key_facts: Says the policies don't give a phone number
notes: Off-topic control. Confirmed by grep: no phone number or hours in any policy, including the ones that say "contact support".

question: If I send back a pair of boots I don't like, how long until I see the money on my card?
expected_answer: Within 5 business days after the boots arrive at the warehouse and pass inspection. Your bank may take another 3–10 business days to show it.
key_facts: Within 5 business days after the return arrives and passes inspection

question: Can I swap my hiking boots for a half size bigger?
expected_answer: Yes. You can exchange for the same product in a different size within the return window. It's free within Canada; you pay or get back any price difference.
key_facts: Yes
Same product in a different size, within the return window

question: I opened a GPS unit and want to ship it back to you. Will I be charged anything?
expected_answer: Yes. A 15% restocking fee for opened electronics, plus the $8.95 label fee for mailed returns in Canada (waived for Summit members or in-store returns).
key_facts: 15% restocking fee
$8.95 return label fee
